_comment: Calibrated against cTrader 5.7.14 (2026) using screenshots of the real Algo → cBot → Backtesting/Optimisation UI. Text-labelled elements (tab names, dialog field labels, checkboxes, result columns) use Name selectors and should be reliable. Toolbar ICON buttons (gear, play, stop, param-settings) and the date-picker fields carry no visible text, so their AutomationId/ClassName values below are PLACEHOLDERS marked with `needsInspect: true` — run `dotnet run -- --inspect` and replace them with the real identifiers from the dumped UI tree. See docs/CALIBRATION.md.

AlgoSidebarItem.description: The 'Algo' item in cTrader's left sidebar (opens the cBots list).

CBotInstanceRow.description: A cBot instance row in the left cBots list, matched by the instance/bot display name (substituted at runtime). Clicking it opens that instance's editor with the EURUSD-h1 / Backtesting / Optimisation tabs. The instance is expected to already be on the symbol+timeframe the job wants (see docs/JOBS.md — jobs target a preconfigured instance rather than switching the chart).

BacktestingTab.description: The 'Backtesting' tab at the top of an open cBot editor.

OptimisationTab.description: The 'Optimisation' tab at the top of an open cBot editor. Note British spelling.

BacktestSettingsButton.description: Gear icon at the far left of the Backtesting/Optimisation toolbar — opens the 'Backtesting settings' dialog (starting capital, commission, data).

StartingCapitalField.description: 'Starting capital' text field in the Backtesting settings dialog.

CommissionField.description: 'Commission' text field in the Backtesting settings dialog (disabled while 'Apply commission automatically' is ticked).

ApplyCommissionAutomaticallyCheckbox.description: 'Apply commission automatically' checkbox in the Backtesting settings dialog.

DataModeDropdown.description: 'Data' dropdown in the Backtesting settings dialog (e.g. 'Tick data from server (accurate)', 'm1 bars from server', etc).

SettingsDialogCloseButton.description: Closes/confirms the Backtesting settings dialog. Often clicking outside the popup dismisses it; this is the explicit control if present.

FromDatePicker.description: Backtest/optimisation range START date field on the toolbar (format dd/MM/yyyy). Left of the range slider.

ToDatePicker.description: Backtest/optimisation range END date field on the toolbar (format dd/MM/yyyy). Right of the range slider.

VisualModeCheckbox.description: 'Visual Mode' checkbox on the Backtesting toolbar. The agent unchecks this for speed.

StartButton.description: Play (▶) button on the toolbar that starts the backtest/optimisation run.

ParametersPanel.description: The left-hand Parameters panel of an open cBot editor (grouped by headers like '00 System', '01 Bias/Regime'). Used to set fixed parameter values for a Backtest job.

ParameterRow.description: A single parameter row in the Parameters panel, matched by its label (substituted at runtime), e.g. 'EMA Fast'. Its editable value control is a descendant Edit/ComboBox.

OptimisationParamsButton.description: The parameter-settings (sliders) icon on the Optimisation toolbar — opens the 'Parameters' dialog where you tick which parameters to optimise and set their Min/Max/Step (numeric) or value list (boolean), plus the Timeframe multi-select.

OptTimeframeField.description: 'Timeframe' multi-select at the top of the Optimisation Parameters dialog (e.g. 'm1; m5; m15; h1; h4').

OptParameterRow.description: A parameter row in the Optimisation Parameters dialog, matched by label (substituted at runtime). Contains an include checkbox and, for numeric params, Min/Max/Step edit fields (labelled 'Min:', 'Max:', 'Step:').

GeneticAlgorithmButton.description: 'GA' button on the Optimisation toolbar — toggles Genetic Algorithm mode (faster, samples the space) vs full grid. Optional; controlled by job.useGeneticAlgorithm.

AutoselectBestPassCheckbox.description: 'Autoselect the best pass' checkbox on the Optimisation panel.

PassesLabel.description: The 'Passes:' status label on the Optimisation panel, polled to detect progress/completion.

RemainingTimeLabel.description: The 'Remaining time:' status label on the Optimisation panel.

OptimisationResultsGrid.description: The Optimisation results grid. Confirmed columns: Pass, Fitness, Equity, Balance, Net profit, Trades, Winning trades, Losing trades, Profit factor, Max equity, Max balance, Average trade, Pass parameters.

BacktestReportButton.description: Report/results icon at the right of the Backtesting toolbar — opens the backtest report (net profit, profit factor, drawdown, trade stats) after a run completes.

BacktestReportPanel.description: The backtest report/summary panel shown after a completed backtest. Fields mirror the Analyze summary: Net profit, Profit factor, Max balance drawdown, Total trades, Winning/Losing trades, etc.
